---
name: Epic
about: A larger goal that groups several issues on the board
title: "[epic] "
type: Epic
labels: []
---

<!-- The epic holds no work itself: its sub-issues do, and the board sums their estimates.
Examples: a reporting module, platform groundwork, customer support. -->

## Situation

<!-- Where things stand and why the epic exists.
Example: "Customers build their weekly report by hand from exports. A reporting module replaces that." -->

## Stakeholders

<!-- If applicable: the customers who move first, the colleagues who own the outcome, the support threads it answers. -->

## Goal

<!-- What is true when done, from the customer's view.
Example: "Customers receive their weekly report by mail without exporting anything." -->

## Acceptance criteria

<!-- What is checkable when the epic is done, from the customer's view. Sub-issues carry the detailed criteria. Example:
- [ ] A customer can schedule a weekly report and receives it by mail -->

- [ ]

## Scope

<!-- What belongs to the anchor and what doesn't.
Example: "In: weekly schedule, mail delivery. Out: custom report layouts." -->

## Decisions

<!-- Dated. Add, never rewrite.
Example: "2026-10-20: mail delivery only, no in-app inbox." -->

## Open questions

<!-- What must be answered before sub-issues can be refined, e.g. "Which customers move first?" -->

## Links

<!-- Designs, customer threads, related epics. Sub-issues are linked through GitHub, not listed here. -->
